scenes.name: New romantics y la escena del Blitz
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: En el club Billy's y luego el Blitz, Rusty Egan pincha Bowie de Berlín, Iggy, Moroder, Kraftwerk, «Being Boiled», Telex y Yellow Magic Orchestra, y Steve Strange guarda la puerta: maquillaje, sombreros españoles y cortes geométricos, fantasía y escapismo tras ocho horas de trabajo. Visage, superbanda de punks fracasados (Ure, Currie, tres de Magazine), con la tristeza sobrenatural de «Fade to Grey»; Spandau Ballet, elitista y nietzscheano antes de volverse soul; Ultravox reformado con Midge Ure y la glacial «Vienna» (1981). Bowie lo corona con «Ashes to Ashes», con Strange vestido de Pierrot. Martin Rushent, con su sello Genetic, llegó a tenerlos a casi todos.

podcast.title: Music Video Endorsement (1991)
podcast.body: Tony Hadley, the lead singer of Spandau Ballet, publicly endorsed P.M. Dawn's 1991 reboot of his band's song "True" by appearing in P.M. Dawn's music video for "Set Adrift on Memory Bliss." "Tony Hadley gave his endorsement of the rapper's reboot by appearing in PM Dawn's music video."

podcast.title: Charity Gig at 43,000 Feet (2013)
podcast.body: On March 10, 2013, Tony Hadley of Spandau Ballet, along with Kim Wilde, performed a charity gig aboard a British Airways 767 at an altitude of 43,000 feet. This event pushed the boundary of high-altitude concerts, reaching near the operational ceiling of current passenger jets. "Tony Hadley of Spandovalet and Kim Wilde, who performed a charity gig on a British Airway 767 at a height of 43,000 feet."

podcast.title: Charity Gig at 43,000 Feet (2013)
podcast.body: On March 10, 2013, Tony Hadley, alongside Kim Wilde, performed a charity gig aboard a British Airways Boeing 767. The concert took place at an altitude of 43,000 feet, which is considered near the operational ceiling for most passenger jets, making it one of the highest musical performances ever. "Tony Hadley of Spandovalet and Kim Wilde, who performed a charity gig on a British Airway 767 at a height of 43,000 feet."

concerts.title: Highest Airplane Concert (2017)
concerts.body: Tony Hadley, alongside Kim Wilde and others, performed a charity gig aboard a chartered British Airway 767. This performance set a record for the highest airplane concert, reaching an altitude of 43,000 feet. "And the highest airplane concert record belongs to Tony Hadley, he of Spandobele, and 80 star Kim Wilde, among others, who performed a charity gig aboard a chartered British Airway 767, which reached 43,000 feet."
